title: Donut SMP Modpack (unofficial)
description: This is a client side modpack for the Donut SMP.
body:
This is a client side modpack and adds optimization and neccesary mod:
- Anchor Optimizer
Optimizes anchors for the client.
- Client Side Crystals
Optimizes crystals for the client.
- Crosshair Indicator
A better crosshair for any kind of PVP
- Litematica
Lets you import blueprints of structures and blocks.
- NoTextureRotations
Allows you to not get your coordinates leaked by block rotations.
- Optimization mods:
Allows you to improve your peformance to make minecraft look better and smoother.
